I’m checking a seven-operator structure that keeps Melantha on the lower outer lane: her faster kills may replace Spot’s blocking and healing role, while Steward takes over central armor damage. The main uncertainty is keeping Melantha and Ansel alive through the artillery window.

            for enemy_id in operator.blocked_enemy_ids
